Method: 提出 DGS-Net：从单视角点云学习稠密抓取配置；并设计两阶段数据生成流程，先进行稠密单物体抓取合成，再扩展到场景级稠密抓取生成。数据中显式建模抓取偏移与预抓取手势（pre-grasp configuration），用于提供更鲁棒监督。

Result: 数据集包含 307 个物体、240 个多物体场景、35 万以上验证抓取。DGS-Net 在仿真中抓取成功率 88.63%，真实机器人平台 78.98%；平均穿透深度 0.375 mm、穿透体积 559.45 mm^3，优于现有方法。

Conclusion: DGS-Net 在多物体场景下能够从单视角点云端到端预测高质量灵巧抓取，配合所构建的大规模数据集，在仿真与真实平台均表现出较高成功率、较低穿透，体现出较强的有效性与泛化能力。

Abstract: Dexterous grasping in multi-object scene constitutes a fundamental challenge in robotic manipulation. Current mainstream grasping datasets predominantly focus on single-object scenarios and predefined grasp configurations, often neglecting environmental interference and the modeling of dexterous pre-grasp gesture, thereby limiting their generalizability in real-world applications. To address this, we propose DGS-Net, an end-to-end grasp prediction network capable of learning dense grasp configurations from single-view point clouds in multi-object scene. Furthermore, we propose a two-stage grasp data generation strategy that progresses from dense single-object grasp synthesis to dense scene-level grasp generation. Our dataset comprises 307 objects, 240 multi-object scenes, and over 350k validated grasps. By explicitly modeling grasp offsets and pre-grasp configurations, the dataset provides more robust and accurate supervision for dexterous grasp learning. Experimental results show that DGS-Net achieves grasp success rates of 88.63\% in simulation and 78.98\% on a real robotic platform, while exhibiting lower penetration with a mean penetration depth of 0.375 mm and penetration volume of 559.45 mm^3, outperforming existing methods and demonstrating strong effectiveness and generalization capability. Our dataset is available at .

</details>


### [640] [MA-VLCM: A Vision Language Critic Model for Value Estimation of Policies in Multi-Agent Team Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15418)
*Shahil Shaik,Aditya Parameshwaran,Anshul Nayak,Jonathon M. Smereka,Yue Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 用“预训练VLM做集中式critic”替代“从零学critic”，让MARL训练更省样本、泛化更好；执行时仍用轻量策略，适合异构且算力受限的多机器人系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统MARL的集中式critic从零学习样本效率低且跨环境泛化弱；而大型VLA虽有强推理和零样本能力，但直接用于多机器人执行计算代价过高，尤其在异构与算力受限系统中难以落地。

Method: 提出MA-VLCM框架：将预训练VLM微调为多智能体critic，输入包含自然语言任务描述、视觉轨迹观测和结构化多智能体状态；训练时固定/使用该critic进行策略优化，从而避免从零学习集中式价值函数；执行端部署轻量策略以适配异构、资源受限机器人。

Result: 实验表明，在不同VLM骨干下，MA-VLCM在多智能体团队任务的分布内与分布外场景中均表现出良好的零样本回报估计能力，同时提升训练样本效率并保持可部署性。

Conclusion: MA-VLCM通过以预训练视觉-语言模型替代MARL中的集中式critic，能够在不学习critic的情况下提升样本效率，并在分布内外多智能体场景中实现较好的零样本回报估计与泛化。

Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) commonly relies on a centralized critic to estimate the value function. However, learning such a critic from scratch is highly sample-inefficient and often lacks generalization across environments. At the same time, large vision-language-action models (VLAs) trained on internet-scale data exhibit strong multimodal reasoning and zero-shot generalization capabilities, yet directly deploying them for robotic execution remains computationally prohibitive, particularly in heterogeneous multi-robot systems with diverse embodiments and resource constraints. To address these challenges, we propose Multi-Agent Vision-Language-Critic Models (MA-VLCM), a framework that replaces the learned centralized critic in MARL with a pretrained vision-language model fine-tuned to evaluate multi-agent behavior. MA-VLCM acts as a centralized critic conditioned on natural language task descriptions, visual trajectory observations, and structured multi-agent state information. By eliminating critic learning during policy optimization, our approach significantly improves sample efficiency while producing compact execution policies suitable for deployment on resource-constrained robots. Results show good zero-shot return estimation on models with differing VLM backbones on in-distribution and out-of-distribution scenarios in multi-agent team settings

</details>


### [641] [Zero-Shot Generalization from Motion Demonstrations to New Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15445)
*Kilian Freitag,Alvin Combrink,Nadia Figueroa*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 Gaussian Graph，把运动示教从“孤立轨迹”变成“可搜索可组合的图结构”，再用 Stitching 和 Chaining 两种机制把离散规划与连续稳定控制融合，实现少样本、可证明收敛且能泛化到未见任务的机器人运动策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端到端方法虽有泛化潜力但数据与算力成本高；动力系统学习样本效率高且控制稳定，但通常只能处理孤立任务，难以复用示教来组合新行为。因此需要一种能在少样本与稳定控制前提下实现任务组合与泛化的方法。

Method: 提出 Gaussian Graph，将已学习运动基元的空间组成重解释为离散顶点及其连接；在此基础上构建两种框架：1) Stitching：将多个示教片段拼接为时间不变动力系统；2) Chaining：以序列方式链接动力系统以生成复杂运动，并保持收敛保证。

Result: 在仿真与真实机器人实验中，所提方法在新任务上的泛化成功，而基线方法失败，表明 Gaussian Graph 及其 Stitching/Chaining 框架具有有效性。

Conclusion: 该工作通过将离散图搜索与连续动力系统控制结合，实现了在共享工作空间中对孤立示教的可复用与组合，从而在保持稳定性与反应速度的同时提升了对未见任务的泛化能力。

Abstract: Learning motion policies from expert demonstrations is an essential paradigm in modern robotics. While end-to-end models aim for broad generalization, they require large datasets and computationally heavy inference. Conversely, learning dynamical systems (DS) provides fast, reactive, and provably stable control from very few demonstrations. However, existing DS learning methods typically model isolated tasks and struggle to reuse demonstrations for novel behaviors. In this work, we formalize the problem of combining isolated demonstrations within a shared workspace to enable generalization to unseen tasks. The Gaussian Graph is introduced, which reinterprets spatial components of learned motion primitives as discrete vertices with connections to one another. This formulation allows us to bridge continuous control with discrete graph search. We propose two frameworks leveraging this graph: Stitching, for constructing time-invariant DSs, and Chaining, giving a sequence-based DS for complex motions while retaining convergence guarantees. Simulations and real-robot experiments show that these methods successfully generalize to new tasks where baseline methods fail.

</details>


### [642] [RoCo Challenge at AAAI 2026: Benchmarking Robotic Collaborative Manipulation for Assembly Towards Industrial Automation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15469)
*Haichao Liu,Yuheng Zhou,Zhenyu Wu,Ziheng Ji,Ziyu Shan,Qianzhun Wang,Ruixuan Liu,Zhiyuan Yang,Yejun Gu,Shalman Khan,Shijun Yan,Jun Liu,Haiyue Zhu,Changliu Liu,Jianfei Yang,Jingbing Zhang,Ziwei Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出RoCo挑战与数据集，评测行星齿轮箱装配；结果显示双模型长时序多任务学习与失败恢复数据显著提升装配性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推动具身智能从感知到连续动作的范式转变，提升工业机器人装配能力并解放人类重复危险劳动。

Method: 构建RoCo挑战与数据集，基于Isaac Sim建立采集/训练/评测系统，设计仿真与真实两阶段评测；任务为行星齿轮箱装配；引入长时序分阶段评分与高质量遥操作数据。

Result: 超过60队参与；ARC-VLA与RoboCola表现突出；双模型长时序多任务框架有效，失败恢复课程数据对部署至关重要。

Conclusion: RoCo挑战与数据集为工业装配EAI提供了标准化评测与推进路径，展示了有效方法与关键经验。

Abstract: Embodied Artificial Intelligence (EAI) is rapidly developing, gradually subverting previous autonomous systems' paradigms from isolated perception to integrated, continuous action. This transition is highly significant for industrial robotic manipulation, promising to free human workers from repetitive, dangerous daily labor. To benchmark and advance this capability, we introduce the Robotic Collaborative Assembly Assistance (RoCo) Challenge with a dataset towards simulation and real-world assembly manipulation. Set against the backdrop of human-centered manufacturing, this challenge focuses on a high-precision planetary gearbox assembly task, a demanding yet highly representative operation in modern industry. Built upon a self-developed data collection, training, and evaluation system in Isaac Sim, and utilizing a dual-arm robot for real-world deployment, the challenge operates in two phases. The Simulation Round defines fine-grained task phases for step-wise scoring to handle the long-horizon nature of the assembly. The Real-World Round mirrors this evaluation with physical gearbox components and high-quality teleoperated datasets. The core tasks require assembling an epicyclic gearbox from scratch, including mounting three planet gears, a sun gear, and a ring gear. Attracting over 60 teams and 170+ participants from more than 10 countries, the challenge yielded highly effective solutions, most notably ARC-VLA and RoboCola. Results demonstrate that a dual-model framework for long-horizon multi-task learning is highly effective, and the strategic utilization of recovery-from-failure curriculum data is a critical insight for successful deployment. This report outlines the competition setup, evaluation approach, key findings, and future directions for industrial EAI. Our dataset, CAD files, code, and evaluation results can be found at: .

</details>


### [643] [On the Derivation of Tightly-Coupled LiDAR-Inertial Odometry with VoxelMap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15471)
*Zhihao Zhan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: TL;DR：这是一篇“整理与统一”型说明文，不发明新LIO算法，而是把基于VoxelMap的紧耦合LiDAR-IMU在IESKF中的建模与推导完整、规范地讲清楚。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动机是解决现有LIO资料中推导分散、符号不统一、工程与理论脱节的问题，提供一份可直接复用的、从几何到概率估计完整打通的技术说明，既便于实现也便于教学入门。

Method: 方法上以IESKF为估计主线，围绕紧耦合LiDAR-IMU里程计建立统一符号体系，明确几何观测模型、状态误差建模与概率更新关系，并用VoxelMap承载环境表示与匹配约束。

Result: 结果是一份清晰、独立、自包含的数学推导文档：统一了系统架构与估计原理的表达，提升了可读性与可复现性，并可作为技术参考与学习入口。

Conclusion: 本文并未提出新算法，而是给出一个自洽、紧凑的LIO数学表述：在迭代误差状态卡尔曼滤波（IESKF）框架下，结合VoxelMap实现紧耦合LiDAR-IMU状态估计。

Abstract: This note presents a concise mathematical formulation of tightly-coupled LiDAR-Inertial Odometry within an iterated error-state Kalman filter framework using a VoxelMap representation. Rather than proposing a new algorithm, it provides a clear and self-contained derivation that unifies the geometric modeling and probabilistic state estimation through consistent notation and explicit formulations. The document is intended to serve both as a technical reference and as an accessible entry point for a foundational understanding of the system architecture and estimation principles.

</details>


### [644] [Optimal control of differentially flat underactuated planar robots in the perspective of oscillation mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15528)
*Stefano Lovato,Michele Tonan,Matteo Bottin,Matteo Massaro,Alberto Doria,Giulio Rosati*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Underactuated robots are characterized by a larger number of degrees of freedom than actuators and if they are designed with a specific mass distribution, they can be controlled by means of differential flatness theory. This structural property enables the development of lightweight and cost-effective robotic systems with enhanced dexterity. However, a key challenge lies in managing the passive joints, whose control demands precise and comprehensive dynamic modeling of the system. To simplify dynamic models, particularly for low-speed trajectories, friction is often neglected. While this assumption simplifies analysis and control design, it introduces residual oscillations of the end-effector about the target position. In this paper, the possibility of using optimal control along with differential flatness control is investigated to improve the tracking of the planned trajectories. First, the study was carried out through formal analysis, and then, it was validated by means of numerical simulations. Results highlight that optimal control can be used to plan the flat variables considering different (quadratic) performance indices: control effort, i.e. motor torque, and potential energy of the considered underactuated joint. Moreover, the minimization of potential energy can be used to design motion laws that are robust against variation of the stiffness and damping of the underactuated joint, thus reducing oscillations in the case of stiffness/damping mismatch.

</details>


### [645] [From Passive Observer to Active Critic: Reinforcement Learning Elicits Process Reasoning for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15600)
*Yibin Liu,Yaxing Lyu,Daqi Gao,Zhixuan Liang,Weiliang Tang,Shilong Mu,Xiaokang Yang,Yao Mu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出PRIMO R1（7B）用于机器人长时程操作过程监督：用结果导向强化学习+显式思维链，让视频MLLM从“看见事件”升级为“按目标评估进度”；再配合初始/当前状态锚定的时序输入与新数据基准，最终在多场景达到SOTA，MAE降50%，RoboFail达67.0%并超过o1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频MLLM主要在SFT范式下训练，倾向于识别“正在发生什么”，但难以根据最终任务目标评估“当前进展如何”，导致长时程机器人操作中的过程监督不准确。

Method: 提出7B框架PRIMO R1：1）采用基于任务结果的强化学习（outcome-based RL）训练，激励模型显式生成思维链用于进度估计；2）构建结构化时序输入，将视频序列显式锚定在初始状态与当前状态图像之间；3）配套构建PRIMO Dataset与Benchmark进行训练与评测。

Result: 在多种域内环境与域外真实人形机器人场景中达到SOTA；相较专用推理基线，均值绝对误差（MAE）降低50%；相较72B级通用MLLM取得显著相对精度提升；在RoboFail失败检测基准上零样本表现强，准确率67.0%，超过OpenAI o1 6.0%。

Conclusion: PRIMO R1通过将视频多模态大模型从被动“观察者”转变为主动“评估者”，在长时程机器人操作的过程监督与失败检测上实现了当前最优性能，并在规模远小于通用超大模型的情况下取得更高精度与更强泛化能力。

Abstract: Accurate process supervision remains a critical challenge for long-horizon robotic manipulation. A primary bottleneck is that current video MLLMs, trained primarily under a Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) paradigm, function as passive "Observers" that recognize ongoing events rather than evaluating the current state relative to the final task goal. In this paper, we introduce PRIMO R1 (Process Reasoning Induced Monitoring), a 7B framework that transforms video MLLMs into active "Critics". We leverage outcome-based Reinforcement Learning to incentivize explicit Chain-of-Thought generation for progress estimation. Furthermore, our architecture constructs a structured temporal input by explicitly anchoring the video sequence between initial and current state images. Supported by the proposed PRIMO Dataset and Benchmark, extensive experiments across diverse in-domain environments and out-of-domain real-world humanoid scenarios demonstrate that PRIMO R1 achieves state-of-the-art performance. Quantitatively, our 7B model achieves a 50% reduction in the mean absolute error of specialized reasoning baselines, demonstrating significant relative accuracy improvements over 72B-scale general MLLMs. Furthermore, PRIMO R1 exhibits strong zero-shot generalization on difficult failure detection tasks. We establish state-of-the-art performance on RoboFail benchmark with 67.0% accuracy, surpassing closed-source models like OpenAI o1 by 6.0%.

</details>


### [646] [EAAE: Energy-Aware Autonomous Exploration for UAVs in Unknown 3D Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15604)
*Jacob Elskamp,Moji Shi,Leonard Bauersfeld,Davide Scaramuzza,Marija Popović*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出能耗感知前沿探索EAAE，通过预测轨迹能耗选目标，显著省电且不损探索效率与地图质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多旋翼在未知环境探索中受电量限制，传统以覆盖/时间为目标的策略易产生高机动能耗，需要显式考虑能耗。

Method: 提出EAAE框架：前沿聚类为视角一致区域；为候选目标规划动态可行轨迹；用离线功率估计预测执行能耗；在双层规划架构中以最小预测能耗选取下一目标并安全执行。

Result: 在模拟3D环境中，相比距离/信息增益前沿基线，总能耗持续下降，同时探索时间具竞争力、地图质量相当。

Conclusion: EAAE在不降低探索时间与地图质量的前提下显著降低能耗，可作为前沿探索的能耗感知层。

Abstract: Battery-powered multirotor unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) can rapidly map unknown environments, but mission performance is often limited by energy rather than geometry alone. Standard exploration policies that optimise for coverage or time can therefore waste energy through manoeuvre-heavy trajectories. In this paper, we address energy-aware autonomous 3D exploration for multirotor UAVs in initially unknown environments. We propose Energy-Aware Autonomous Exploration (EAAE), a modular frontier-based framework that makes energy an explicit decision variable during frontier selection. EAAE clusters frontiers into view-consistent regions, plans dynamically feasible candidate trajectories to the most informative clusters, and predicts their execution energy using an offline power estimation loop. The next target is then selected by minimising predicted trajectory energy while preserving exploration progress through a dual-layer planning architecture for safe execution. We evaluate EAAE in a full exploration pipeline with a rotor-speed-based power model across simulated 3D environments of increasing complexity. Compared to representative distance-based and information gain-based frontier baselines, EAAE consistently reduces total energy consumption while maintaining competitive exploration time and comparable map quality, providing a practical drop-in energy-aware layer for frontier exploration.

</details>


### [647] [Perception-Aware Autonomous Exploration in Feature-Limited Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15605)
*Moji Shi,Rajitha de Silva,Hang Yu,Riccardo Polvara,Marija Popović*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 面向VIO的层次化感知探索与连续偏航优化可在低纹理环境中显著提升覆盖率与定位稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统探索侧重覆盖效率，忽略VIO对视觉特征的依赖，易引导机器人进入特征稀疏区导致跟踪退化、漂移和任务失败。

Method: 为双目无人机提出层次化感知探索：用全局特征图评估前沿点的预期特征质量并优先选择视觉信息丰富的子目标；同时在规划运动上优化连续偏航轨迹以维持稳定特征轨迹。

Result: 在仿真与室内实测中，相比忽略特征质量或不优化连续偏航的基线，方法实现更可靠特征跟踪、更小漂移，且在误差阈值前平均覆盖率提升约30%。

Conclusion: 所提层次化感知感知探索框架能在不同纹理环境中提升特征跟踪稳定性、降低里程计漂移，并在误差阈值前获得更高覆盖率。

Abstract: Autonomous exploration in unknown environments typically relies on onboard state estimation for localisation and mapping. Existing exploration methods primarily maximise coverage efficiency, but often overlook that visual-inertial odometry (VIO) performance strongly depends on the availability of robust visual features. As a result, exploration policies can drive a robot into feature-sparse regions where tracking degrades, leading to odometry drift, corrupted maps, and mission failure. We propose a hierarchical perception-aware exploration framework for a stereo-equipped unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) that explicitly couples exploration progress with feature observability. Our approach (i) associates each candidate frontier with an expected feature quality using a global feature map, and prioritises visually informative subgoals, and (ii) optimises a continuous yaw trajectory along the planned motion to maintain stable feature tracks. We evaluate our method in simulation across environments with varying texture levels and in real-world indoor experiments with largely textureless walls. Compared to baselines that ignore feature quality and/or do not optimise continuous yaw, our method maintains more reliable feature tracking, reduces odometry drift, and achieves on average 30\% higher coverage before the odometry error exceeds specified thresholds.

</details>

### [648] [Research Paradigm of Materials Science Tetrahedra with Artificial Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13744)
*Shiyun Zhang,Yibo Yao,Haoquan Long,Dingwen Tao,Guangming Tan,Wei-Hua Wang,Yuan-Chao Hu*

Main category: cond-mat.mtrl-sci

TL;DR: 这篇文章是“范式论文”：从经典材料四面体出发，提出两个AI时代的新框架（AI for materials 与 AI methodology），目的是把材料科学问题与数据、模型、智能体及AI算法环节系统连接起来，帮助研究者更理性地定义并解决可落地的AI for Science问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典材料研究范式虽有效，但在AI快速发展背景下，现有实验/建模/理论流程难以充分吸收数据驱动与智能增强能力；同时AI在自然语言与视觉的成功难以直接迁移到自然科学，亟需新的跨域研究范式。

Method: 作者采用概念框架与范式重构的方法：以经典“材料四面体（结构-性质-工艺-性能-表征）”为基线，提出两个新范式——（1）面向材料科学的Matter-Data-Model-Potential-Agent四面体；（2）面向AI研究的Data-Architecture-Encoding-Optimization-Inference关系图，并分析关键要素及其耦合关系。

Result: 论文的主要产出是两套可操作的概念范式与要素关系：一套用于组织AI赋能材料研究流程，另一套用于刻画AI方法学内部关键环节。该工作为后续研究提供了统一认知框架与问题拆解路径，而非给出具体实验数值性能。

Conclusion: 本文认为，材料科学与AI融合需要从“追热度”转向“问题驱动”，通过清晰、可分解的科学问题与系统化框架，才能真正释放AI for Science的价值。

Abstract: The classical material tetrahedron that represents the Structure-Property-Processing-Performance-Characterization relationship is the most important research paradigm in materials science so far. It has served as a protocol to guide experiments, modeling, and theory to uncover hidden relationships between various aspects of a certain material. This substantially facilitates knowledge accumulation and material discovery with desired functionalities to realize versatile applications. In recent years, with the advent of artificial intelligence (AI) techniques, the attention of AI towards scientific research is soaring. The trials of implementing AI in various disciplines are endless, with great potential to revolutionize the research diagram. Despite the success in natural language processing and computer vision, how to effectively integrate AI with natural science is still a grand challenge, bearing in mind their fundamental differences. Inspired by these observations and limitations, we delve into the current research paradigm dictated by the classical material tetrahedron and propose two new paradigms to stimulate data-driven and AI-augmented research. One tetrahedron focuses on AI for materials science by considering the Matter-Data-Model-Potential-Agent diagram. The other demonstrates AI research by discussing Data-Architecture-Encoding-Optimization-Inference relationships. The crucial ingredients of these frameworks and their connections are discussed, which will likely motivate both scientific thinking refinement and technology advancement. Despite the widespread enthusiasm for chasing AI for science, we must analyze issues rationally to come up with well-defined, resolvable scientific problems in order to better master the power of AI.

</details>


### [649] [Benchmarking Machine Learning Approaches for Polarization Mapping in Ferroelectrics Using 4D-STEM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15582)
*Matej Martinc,Goran Dražič,Anton Kokalj,Katarina Žiberna,Janina Roknić,Matic Poberžnik,Sašo Džeroski,Andreja Benčan Golob*

Main category: cond-mat.mtrl-sci

TL;DR: 对多种机器学习模型进行4D-STEM极化方向识别评测，指出模拟-实验域差距是关键瓶颈，并展示定制表征训练与PCA方法能改善跨域表现，且预测异常可反映晶体缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从4D-STEM中自动提取铁电材料极化方向等物理属性具有重要意义，但从衍射图样中准确识别极化方向存在困难，尤其是模拟与实验数据之间的域差距。

Method: 系统比较ResNet、VGG、自定义CNN与PCA+kNN等模型，对4D-STEM衍射图样进行极化方向自动识别；采用合成数据训练，并引入定制表征训练、数据增强与过滤以提升跨域泛化。

Result: 合成数据上模型准确率高，但在真实实验数据上受域差距限制；定制表征训练与PCA方法更能桥接差距；误差分析发现周期性误分类，且预测异常与晶体缺陷相关。

Conclusion: 研究表明，基于定制表征训练与PCA方法并结合数据增强和过滤，可在一定程度上缩小模拟与实验4D-STEM数据的域差距，为稳健、可迁移的电子显微分析模型提供指导。

Abstract: Four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM) provides rich, atomic-scale insights into materials structures. However, extracting specific physical properties - such as polarization directions essential for understanding functional properties of ferroelectrics - remains a significant challenge. In this study, we systematically benchmark multiple machine learning models, namely ResNet, VGG, a custom convolutional neural network, and PCA-informed k-Nearest Neighbors, to automate the detection of polarization directions from 4D-STEM diffraction patterns in ferroelectric potassium sodium niobate. While models trained on synthetic data achieve high accuracy on idealized synthetic diffraction patterns of equivalent thickness, the domain gap between simulation and experiment remains a critical barrier to real-world deployment. In this context, a custom made prototype representation training regime and PCA-based methods, combined with data augmentation and filtering, can better bridge this gap. Error analysis reveals periodic missclassification patterns, indicating that not all diffraction patterns carry enough information for a successful classification. Additionally, our qualitative analysis demonstrates that irregularities in the model's prediction patterns correlate with defects in the crystal structure, suggesting that supervised models could be used for detecting structural defects. These findings guide the development of robust, transferable machine learning tools for electron microscopy analysis.

</details>


### [650] [Agentic workflow enables the recovery of critical materials from complex feedstocks via selective precipitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15491)
*Andrew Ritchhart,Sarah I. Allec,Pravalika Butreddy,Krista Kulesa,Qingpu Wang,Dan Thien Nguyen,Maxim Ziatdinov,Elias Nakouzi*

Main category: cond-mat.mtrl-sci

TL;DR: 用“AI多智能体+自动化仪器+简单试剂”做关键材料回收，在真实废液中实现选择性沉淀，把工艺开发从月/年缩短到天。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关键材料回收面临原料复杂、工艺开发慢、传统分离优化耗时长（常需数月到数年）等问题，亟需更高效、可适配且可扩展的开发范式。

Method: 构建多智能体协同流程，结合AI决策与自动化实验设备，在产出水和磁体浸出液两类真实进料中，使用简单化学试剂开展选择性沉淀分离与回收。

Result: 在真实工业相关进料上实现了选择性沉淀回收；相较传统路线，将分离流程开发时间从数月/数年级压缩到数天级。

Conclusion: 该工作证明了由多智能体AI与自动化仪器组成的工作流可以在真实复杂原料中快速实现关键材料的选择性沉淀回收，并显著缩短分离工艺开发周期。

Abstract: We present a multi-agentic workflow for critical materials recovery that deploys a series of AI agents and automated instruments to recover critical materials from produced water and magnet leachates. This approach achieves selective precipitation from real-world feedstocks using simple chemicals, accelerating the development of efficient, adaptable, and scalable separations to a timeline of days, rather than months and years.

</details>
