# econ.GN [[Back]](#toc)

### [809] [The AI Transformation Gap Index (AITG): An Empirical Framework for Measuring AI Transformation Opportunity, Disruption Risk, and Value Creation at the Industry and Firm Level](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13278)
*Dean Barr*

Main category: econ.GN

TL;DR: 论文提出AITG：把“企业离AI行业前沿有多远”量化，并转换成“可实现价值、执行可行性与不转型风险”。在多行业校准和公司样本测试中，指标与利润率改善高度同向相关，但仅属相关证据。关键洞见是：AI缺口大≠价值必然大，落地摩擦与瓶颈会吃掉理论收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前市场虽大量投入AI，但缺乏统一的、可跨行业比较且能映射到审计级财务结果的实证基准；现有做法多依赖主观成熟度标签，难以支持投资与战略决策。

Method: 提出由五个模块组成的复合实证框架：IASS（跨行业归一化）、AFC（动态能力前沿）、IFS（含执行风险的轨迹评分）、VCB（基于 CES 瓶颈的价值分解）、ADRI（不作为竞争风险）。在22个行业进行校准，并基于公开披露数据应用于14家上市公司；另做回顾性构念效度检验，将AITG分数与EBITDA利润率扩张做Spearman相关。

Result: 在n=10样本的回顾检验中，AITG分数与EBITDA利润率扩张的Spearman rho_s=0.818，方向上支持框架预测，但不足以建立因果识别。并发现反直觉现象：最大转型缺口并不对应最高价值密度。

Conclusion: AITG 提供了一个可审计、可比较、可量化的企业 AI 转型评估框架；但“转型缺口越大、价值越高”并不总成立，实际价值会被实施摩擦、生产要素瓶颈与时滞显著削弱。

Abstract: Despite the scale of capital being deployed toward AI initiatives, no empirical framework currently exists for benchmarking where a firm stands relative to competitors in AI readiness and deployment, or for translating that position into auditable financial outcomes. In practice, private equity deal teams, management consultants, and corporate strategists have relied on qualitative judgment and ad-hoc maturity labels; tools that are neither comparable across industries nor grounded in observable economic data. This paper introduces the AI Transformation Gap Index (AITG), a composite empirical framework that measures the distance between a firm's current AI deployment and a time varying, industry constrained capability frontier, then maps that distance to dollar denominated value creation, execution feasibility under uncertainty, and competitive disruption risk. Five linked modules address this gap: cross industry normalization (IASS), a dynamic capability ceiling that evolves with frontier capabilities (AFC), trajectory based firm scoring with integrated execution risk (IFS), a CES bottleneck value decomposition mapping gap scores to enterprise value (VCB), and a competitive hazard measure for inaction (ADRI). I calibrate the framework for 22 industry verticals and apply it to 14 public companies using public filings. A retrospective construct validity exercise correlating AITG scores with observed EBITDA margin expansion yields Spearman rho_s = 0.818 (n = 10), directionally consistent with predictions though insufficient for causal identification. A counterintuitive result emerges: the largest AI transformation gaps do not produce the highest value density, because implementation friction, CES bottlenecks, and timing lags erode the theoretical upside of wide gaps.

</details>


<div id='physics.ed-ph'></div>

# physics.ed-ph [[Back]](#toc)

### [810] [Criterion-referenceability determines LLM-as-a-judge validity across physics assessment formats](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.14732)
*Will Yeadon,Tom Hardy,Paul Mackay,Elise Agra*

Main category: physics.ed-ph

TL;DR: LLM在结构化与可观测特征明确的任务上可较好评卷，论文类任务区分效度接近无效；标准答案有益，错误答案影响绝对分但排序仍较稳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 明确LLM用于自动评测与反馈时在何种条件下可被信任。

Method: 比较多种LLM与人工在不同物理评测形式（结构化题、论文、科学绘图）下的评分一致性与区分效度，在盲评、给出标准答案、错误答案与示例锚定条件下评估MAE与Spearman相关。

Result: 结构化题与绘图任务中LLM具有较高区分效度（如ρ>0.6/0.84），提供标准答案可提升一致性；错误答案主要降低绝对准确度但排序仍较稳。论文评分区分效度很差（ρ≈0~0.1），示例锚定可匹配均值与方差但仍缺乏有效区分。

Conclusion: LLM评卷的有效性主要取决于任务是否具备明确可观察的评分特征与基准可靠性，而非模型能力本身。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for automated assessment and feedback, understanding when LLM marking can be trusted is essential. We evaluate LLM-as-a-judge marking across three physics assessment formats - structured questions, written essays, and scientific plots - comparing GPT-5.2, Grok 4.1, Claude Opus 4.5, DeepSeek-V3.2, Gemini Pro 3, and committee aggregations against human markers under blind, solution-provided, false-solution, and exemplar-anchored conditions. For $n=771$ blind university exam questions, models achieve fractional mean absolute errors (fMAE) $\approx 0.22$ with robust discriminative validity (Spearman $\rho > 0.6$). For secondary and university structured questions ($n=1151$), providing official solutions reduces MAE and strengthens validity (committee $\rho = 0.88$); false solutions degrade absolute accuracy but leave rank ordering largely intact (committee $\rho = 0.77$; individual models $\rho \geq 0.59$). Essay marking behaves fundamentally differently. Across $n=55$ scripts ($n=275$ essays), blind AI marking is harsher and more variable than human marking, with discriminative validity already poor ($\rho \approx 0.1$). Adding a mark scheme does not improve discrimination ($\rho \approx 0$; all confidence intervals include zero). Anchored exemplars shift the AI mean close to the human mean and compress variance below the human standard deviation, but discriminative validity remains near-zero - distributional agreement can occur without valid discrimination. For code-based plot elements ($n=1400$), models achieve exceptionally high discriminative validity ($\rho > 0.84$) with near-linear calibration. Across all task types, validity tracks criterion-referenceability - the extent to which a task maps to explicit, observable grading features - and benchmark reliability, rather than raw model capability.

</details>


<div id='stat.ME'></div>

# stat.ME [[Back]](#toc)

### [811] [Beyond Means: Topological Causal Effects under Persistent-Homology Ignorability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.14169)
*Amir Saki,Usef Faghihi*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 用持久同调定义拓扑因果效应，解决均值不变但分布形态改变的效应识别，并给出可识别性与实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统ATE/CATE只反映均值变化，可能忽略治疗导致的分布几何/拓扑结构变化。

Method: 基于持久同调构建拓扑因果框架，提出拓扑版ATE/CATE，定义拓扑可忽略性并给出可识别性与误差界；分析条件与边际持久同调在混合下不交换的问题。

Result: 证明在近似拓扑可忽略性下拓扑效应可识别；指出仅有条件拓扑可忽略性不足以识别边际持久同调效应；合成实验显示均值效应近零而拓扑效应显著且可经混杂调整恢复。

Conclusion: 拓扑因果效应能够捕捉均值不变但分布形态改变的处理效应，且在近似拓扑可忽略性下可识别。

Abstract: Average treatment effects (ATE) and conditional average treatment effects (CATE) are foundational causal estimands, but they target changes in expected outcomes and can miss treatment-induced changes in the shape of outcome distributions. A canonical failure mode occurs when control outcomes are unimodal, treated outcomes become bimodal, and both distributions have the same mean. In such cases mean-based causal estimands are zero even though the geometry and topology of the outcome law change substantially. This paper develops a topological causal framework based on persistent homology. We formalize a persistent-homology ignorability condition, define topological analogues of CATE and ATE, and prove that these estimands are identifiable up to an explicit error bound under approximate topological ignorability. We also clarify a subtle but important point: a marginal persistence-diagram effect is not identified from conditional topological ignorability alone because persistent homology does not in general commute with mixtures over covariates. To preserve the original intuition while ensuring scientific correctness, we retain the marginal effect as a motivating quantity, but place the mathematically sound conditional estimands at the center of the theory. A synthetic experiment with mean-preserving topology change shows that mean-based causal estimands remain near zero while the proposed topological effect increases sharply and remains recoverable after adjustment for confounding.

</details>


<div id='hep-ph'></div>

# hep-ph [[Back]](#toc)

### [812] [An End-to-end Architecture for Collider Physics and Beyond](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.14553)
*Shi Qiu,Zeyu Cai,Jiashen Wei,Zeyu Li,Yixuan Yin,Qing-Hong Cao,Chang Liu,Ming-xing Luo,Xing-Bo Yuan,Hua Xing Zhu*

Main category: hep-ph

TL;DR: 提出语言驱动的ColliderAgent，自动完成碰撞现象学全流程，并在多类物理场景中验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 降低高能物理现象学研究对特定软件包与人工流程的依赖，推动自动化与标准化研究。

Method: 构建去耦合、领域无关架构的ColliderAgent，结合层级多智能体推理与统一执行后端Magnus，实现从拉格朗日量到模拟与分析的完整工作流。

Result: 在轻子夸克、类轴子粒子、有效算符、部分子/探测器级分析及大规模参数扫描等案例中复现文献结果并获得排除限。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了语言驱动的多智能体系统可实现从理论到现象学结果的端到端自动化流程，提升高能物理研究的可扩展性与可复现性。

Abstract: We present, to our knowledge, the first language-driven agent system capable of executing end-to-end collider phenomenology tasks, instantiated within a decoupled, domain-agnostic architecture for autonomous High-Energy Physics phenomenology. Guided only by natural-language prompts supplemented with standard physics notation, ColliderAgent carries out workflows from a theoretical Lagrangian to final phenomenological outputs without relying on package-specific code. In this framework, a hierarchical multi-agent reasoning layer is coupled to Magnus, a unified execution backend for phenomenological calculations and simulation toolchains. We validate the system on representative literature reproductions spanning leptoquark and axion-like-particle scenarios, higher-dimensional effective operators, parton-level and detector-level analyses, and large-scale parameter scans leading to exclusion limits. These results point to a route toward more automated, scalable, and reproducible research in collider physics, cosmology, and physics more broadly.

</details>


<div id='cs.GR'></div>

# cs.GR [[Back]](#toc)

### [813] [Masked BRep Autoencoder via Hierarchical Graph Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.14927)
*Yifei Li,Kang Wu,Wenming Wu,Xiaoming Fu*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 提出自监督BRep表示学习框架：掩码图自编码器+层次图Transformer，预训练后小样本微调，多个CAD任务上显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 降低对标注数据的依赖，学习可迁移的CAD表示以支持多种下游任务。

Method: 构建BRep无标注数据集，采用掩码图自编码器重建被遮蔽的几何与属性；使用层次化图Transformer，结合跨尺度互注意力建模长程依赖与GNN聚合局部拓扑；预训练后以任务特定头进行微调。

Result: 在零部件分类、分割与加工特征识别等任务上，即便标注数据很少也取得显著优于现有方法的表现。

Conclusion: 该框架在少量标注数据下仍具高性能与良好泛化，适用于多种CAD下游任务。

Abstract: We introduce a novel self-supervised learning framework that automatically learns representations from input computer-aided design (CAD) models for downstream tasks, including part classification, modeling segmentation, and machining feature recognition. To train our network, we construct a large-scale, unlabeled dataset of boundary representation (BRep) models. The success of our algorithm relies on two keycomponents. The first is a masked graph autoencoder that reconstructs randomly masked geometries and attributes of BReps for representation learning to enhance the generalization. The second is a hierarchical graph Transformer architecture that elegantly fuses global and local learning by a cross-scale mutual attention block to model long-range geometric dependencies and a graph neural network block to aggregate local topological information. After training the autoencoder, we replace its decoder with a task-specific network trained on a small amount of labeled data for downstream tasks. We conduct experiments on various tasks and achieve high performance, even with a small amount of labeled data, demonstrating the practicality and generalizability of our model. Compared to other methods, our model performs significantly better on downstream tasks with the same amount of training data, particularly when the training data is very limited.

</details>


### [814] [Adaptive GPU Kinetic Solver for Fluid-Granular Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.14982)
*Xingqiao Li,Kui Wu,Haozhe Su,Tianhong Gao,Mengyu Chu,Chenfanfu Jiang,Wei Li,Baoquan Chen*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: TL;DR：作者把LBM（流体）和MPM（颗粒）统一到一个GPU友好的多层自适应框架里，通过跨层级一致重标定和细网格耦合约束，实现了大规模流体-沙/雪双向耦合仿真，既快又真实。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流体-颗粒系统因连续介质与离散介质之间强非线性耦合，难以在大规模仿真中兼顾物理保真度与计算效率。该工作旨在解决这一核心矛盾，并支持自然灾害、工业过程及图形学视觉效果中的复杂现象。

Method: 方法上采用LBM模拟连续流体、MPM模拟离散颗粒（如沙与雪），并设计基于几何固体结构的分块多层HOME-LBM自适应求解器；通过一致的矩重标定律在细化层级接口上传递宏观量；使用GPU动态维护多级块；并约束MPM粒子位于最细流体节点中，以保证稳定且准确的双向耦合。

Result: 框架可模拟雪崩、沙尘暴、沙迁移等大尺度现象；在多分辨率网格下保持较好的精度与稳定性；借助自适应分块和GPU维护机制提升了内存利用率与计算性能，展示出高物理真实性和高效率。

Conclusion: 该工作提出了一个统一且可扩展的流体-颗粒耦合仿真框架，通过多级自适应HOME-LBM与MPM双向耦合，在大规模场景下同时实现了较高物理真实性与计算效率。

Abstract: Simulating fluid-granular flows is crucial for understanding natural disasters, industrial processes, and visually realistic phenomena in computer graphics. These systems are challenging to simulate because of the strong nonlinear coupling between continuum fluids and discrete granular media, making it difficult to achieve both physical fidelity and computational efficiency at large scales. In this work, we present a unified framework for large-scale fluid-granular simulation that couples the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) for fluids with the Material Point Method (MPM) for granular materials such as sand and snow. We introduce an adaptive block-based multi-level HOME-LBM solver based on solid geometric structures, enabling efficient memory usage and computational performance across multiple lattice resolutions. Consistent rescaling laws for moments allow accurate transfer of macroscopic quantities across refinement interfaces, while a GPU-based algorithm dynamically maintains the multi-level blocks in response to particle motion. By enforcing that all MPM particles reside within the finest fluid nodes, we achieve accurate two-way coupling between fluid and granular phases. Our framework supports a wide range of large-scale phenomena, including snow avalanches, sandstorms, and sand migration, demonstrating high physical fidelity and computational efficiency.

</details>


### [815] [A Texture Lookup Approach to Bézier Curve Evaluation on the GPU](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15447)
*Muhammad Anas,Alan Wolfe*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 把Bezier求值从shader算术运算转移到GPU纹理线性插值硬件，可在算力瓶颈场景提速；框架还能支持曲面/体、B-spline、NURBS与有理形式，并可结合Seiler插值进一步提效，同时保持可比较的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统在shader中以多项式形式求值Bezier曲线会占用算力，在compute-bound GPU负载下可能成为瓶颈，因此需要利用现有硬件单元（纹理插值器）降低计算压力、提升吞吐。

Method: 提出一种基于纹理的Bezier求值方法：将曲线计算卸载到GPU纹理插值器（固定功能单元）而非仅在shader中做多项式计算；并将Seiler插值纳入同一框架以进一步提升效率；同时扩展到曲面、体以及B样条、NURBS、整数/有理多项式。

Result: 与在shader代码中直接多项式求值相比，文中方法在计算受限工作负载中表现出更好的性能，并给出了与精度相关的对比分析；同时展示了方法在更高维几何与高级曲线模型中的自然适用性。

Conclusion: 该工作证明了利用GPU固定功能纹理线性插值硬件进行Bezier曲线求值是可行且高效的，在计算受限场景下可带来性能收益，并且可扩展到更广泛的曲线/曲面表示。

Abstract: We present a texture-based technique for evaluating Bézier curves on the GPU that leverages fixed-function linear texture interpolation hardware. By offloading curve evaluation to the texture interpolator, this approach can improve performance in compute-bound GPU workloads. The method can also be used naturally for Bézier surfaces and volumes and extends to advanced curve types such as B-splines, NURBS, and both integral and rational polynomials. We show how Seiler interpolation fits into this framework to improve efficiency. We also compare performance and accuracy against curves evaluated as polynomials in shader code.

</details>


<div id='cs.SE'></div>

# cs.SE [[Back]](#toc)

### [816] [CangjieBench: Benchmarking LLMs on a Low-Resource General-Purpose Programming Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.14501)
*Junhang Cheng,Fang Liu,Jia Li,Chengru Wu,Nanxiang Jiang,Li Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出CangjieBench并评估多设置LLM：语法约束生成最均衡，Agent最准但昂贵，代码到代码有负迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低资源通用编程语言研究不足，现有工作偏向DSL；需评估LLM在低资源通用语言上的泛化能力。

Method: 构建无污染CangjieBench，手工从HumanEval与ClassEval翻译248样本；在Direct、Syntax-Constrained、RAG与Agent四种设置下评估多种LLM，比较文本到代码与代码到代码任务。

Result: Direct表现较差；语法约束生成效果与成本权衡最好；Agent达到SOTA但token消耗高；代码到代码通常劣于文本到代码，呈现负迁移。

Conclusion: 提出CangjieBench并系统评估多种设置，发现语法约束生成在准确率与成本之间最佳平衡，Agent准确率最高但代价大，代码到代码存在负迁移。

Abstract: Large Language Models excel in high-resource programming languages but struggle with low-resource ones. Existing research related to low-resource programming languages primarily focuses on Domain-Specific Languages (DSLs), leaving general-purpose languages that suffer from data scarcity underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce CangjieBench, a contamination-free benchmark for Cangjie, a representative low-resource general-purpose language. The benchmark comprises 248 high-quality samples manually translated from HumanEval and ClassEval, covering both Text-to-Code and Code-to-Code tasks. We conduct a systematic evaluation of diverse LLMs under four settings: Direct Generation, Syntax-Constrained Generation, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agent. Experiments reveal that Direct Generation performs poorly, whereas Syntax-Constrained Generation offers the best trade-off between accuracy and computational cost. Agent achieve state-of-the-art accuracy but incur high token consumption. Furthermore, we observe that Code-to-Code translation often underperforms Text-to-Code generation, suggesting a negative transfer phenomenon where models overfit to the source language patterns. We hope that our work will offer valuable insights into LLM generalization to unseen and low-resource programming languages. Our code and data are available at .

</details>


### [817] [To See is Not to Master: Teaching LLMs to Use Private Libraries for Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15159)
*Yitong Zhang,Chengze Li,Ruize Chen,Guowei Yang,Xiaoran Jia,Yijie Ren,Jia Li*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: PriCoder通过“图演化+图剪枝”的自动数据合成策略，专门训练LLM学会调用私有库API，在新建基准上将私有库代码生成pass@1大幅提升（常见>20%），且几乎不损伤通用代码能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法主要依赖在推理时检索并注入私有库API文档，但作者发现即使提供准确知识，LLM仍难以有效调用私有库API，因此需要一种能在训练层面系统提升API调用能力的方法。

Method: 提出PriCoder：将私有库数据合成建模为图构建过程，并交替执行两类算子——（1）渐进式图演化（Progressive Graph Evolution），从基础样本逐步扩展到更多样训练样本以提升多样性；（2）多维图剪枝（Multidimensional Graph Pruning），通过严格过滤流程提升样本质量。

Result: 在3个主流LLM上的实验表明，PriCoder在私有库导向代码生成任务中显著提升性能，许多设置下pass@1提升超过20%；同时对通用代码生成能力几乎无负面影响。作者还构建并公开了两个基于新近发布、对模型不熟悉库的基准以支持严格评测。

Conclusion: PriCoder通过自动合成数据有效提升了LLM在私有库API调用与代码生成上的能力，并且对通用代码生成能力影响很小，说明该方法在专用能力增强与通用能力保持之间取得了良好平衡。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for code generation, yet they remain limited in private-library-oriented code generation, where the goal is to generate code using APIs from private libraries. Existing approaches mainly rely on retrieving private-library API documentation and injecting relevant knowledge into the context at inference time. However, our study shows that this is insufficient: even given accurate required knowledge, LLMs still struggle to invoke private-library APIs effectively. To address this limitation, we propose PriCoder, an approach that teaches LLMs to invoke private-library APIs through automatically synthesized data. Specifically, PriCoder models private-library data synthesis as the construction of a graph, and alternates between two graph operators: (1) Progressive Graph Evolution, which improves data diversity by progressively synthesizing more diverse training samples from basic ones, and (2) Multidimensional Graph Pruning, which improves data quality through a rigorous filtering pipeline. To support rigorous evaluation, we construct two new benchmarks based on recently released libraries that are unfamiliar to the tested models. Experiments on three mainstream LLMs show that PriCoder substantially improves private-library-oriented code generation, yielding gains of over 20% in pass@1 in many settings, while causing negligible impact on general code generation capability. Our code and benchmarks are publicly available at .

</details>


### [818] [Formalisms for Robotic Mission Specification and Execution: A Comparative Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15427)
*Gianluca Filippone,Sara Pettinari,Patrizio Pelliccione*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 系统比较四种任务规范形式化方法的表达力、局限与工具支持，为机器人任务建模选型提供依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人系统复杂度提升且任务多样，现场专家需要可扩展、可表达的任务规范，但缺乏统一标准。

Method: 对四种形式化任务规范方法的控制结构与任务概念进行系统分析，评估其表达能力、局限性与工具支持，并通过专家验证比较结论。

Result: 给出四种形式化方法在机器人任务规范中的适用性、优势与不足的比较性结论。

Conclusion: 论文认为对行为树、状态机、HTN与BPMN的系统性比较可揭示其在机器人任务建模中的优缺点，帮助选择合适的任务规范方法。

Abstract: Robots are increasingly deployed across diverse domains and designed for multi-purpose operation. As robotic systems grow in complexity and operate in dynamic environments, the need for structured, expressive, and scalable mission-specification approaches becomes critical, with mission specifications often defined in the field by domain experts rather than robotics specialists. However, there is no standard or widely accepted formalism for specifying missions in single- or multi-robot systems. A variety of formalisms, such as Behavior Trees, State Machines, Hierarchical Task Networks, and Business Process Model and Notation, have been adopted in robotics to varying degrees, each providing different levels of abstraction, expressiveness, and support for integration with human workflows and external devices. This paper presents a systematic analysis of these four formalisms with respect to their suitability for robot mission specification. Our study focuses on mission-level descriptions rather than robot software development. We analyze their underlying control structures and mission concepts, evaluate their expressiveness and limitations in modeling real-world missions, and assess the extent of available tool support. By comparing the formalisms and validating our findings with experts, we provide insights into their applicability, strengths, and shortcomings in robotic system modeling. The results aim to support practitioners and researchers in selecting appropriate modeling approaches for designing robust and adaptable robot and multi-robot missions.

</details>


### [819] [VulnAgent-X: A Layered Agentic Framework for Repository-Level Vulnerability Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13384)
*Renwei Meng,Haoyi Wu,Jingming Wang,Haoyan Bai*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: VulnAgent-X 通过“筛查→上下文扩展→专用智能体分析→按需动态验证→证据融合”的分阶段流程，显著提升仓库级漏洞检测效果与可解释性，同时减少误报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法主要依赖局部代码视角和一次性预测，且验证不足，难以应对由代码结构、仓库上下文与运行时条件共同作用引发的复杂漏洞，导致真实仓库级场景下可靠性不足。

Method: 提出分层智能体框架 VulnAgent-X：先进行轻量风险筛查，再做有界上下文扩展，随后由专门分析智能体处理，并在必要时进行选择性动态验证，最后进行多源证据融合形成统一判定。

Result: 在函数级与 JIT（Just-In-Time）漏洞基准上，VulnAgent-X 相比静态基线、编码器模型及更简单的智能体方案取得更优表现，并在漏洞定位能力与性能-成本权衡上更均衡。

Conclusion: 将漏洞检测建模为分阶段、证据驱动的审计流程，可在仓库级场景中提升检测质量与可解释性，并降低误报。

Abstract: Software vulnerability detection is critical in software en- gineering as security flaws arise from complex interactions across code structure, repository context, and runtime conditions. Existing meth- ods are limited by local code views, one-shot prediction, and insuffi- cient validation, reducing reliability in realistic repository-level settings. This study proposes VulnAgentX, a layered agentic framework integrat- ing lightweight risk screening, bounded context expansion, specialised analysis agents, selective dynamic verification, and evidence fusion into a unified pipeline. Experiments on function-level and just-in-time vul- nerability benchmarks show VulnAgent-X outperforms static baselines, encoder-based models, and simpler agentic variants, with better local- isation and balanced performance-cost trade-offs. Treating vulnerabil- ity detection as a staged, evidence-driven auditing process improves de- tection quality, reduces false positives, and produces interpretable re- sults for repository-level software security analysis. Code is available at .

</details>


### [820] [Neuro-Symbolic Generation and Validation of Memory-Aware Formal Function Specifications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13414)
*Liao Zhang,Tong Chen,Xiwei Wu,Qi Liu,Xiyu Zhai,Xinqi Wang,Qinxiang Cao*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文聚焦“自动生成C程序内存感知函数规格”，不用难度更高的循环不变式合成。方法是LLM先生成、再用符号工具链反复纠错，并用“证明规格的否定”来机器化淘汰错误规格；在200题基准上显著提升规格质量与可信度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内存操作程序的形式化验证依赖专家编写的精确函数规格，这已成为瓶颈；同时LLM正在大量生成低层系统代码，正确性无法默认，亟需可扩展的自动规格生成方法。

Method: 提出一个神经-符号框架：先用上下文学习根据自然语言题意和函数签名生成候选C函数规格；再利用符号证明器与验证工具链的编译/证明诊断进行迭代修正；并通过对规格否定命题构造带具体样例的证明来反驳错误但貌似合理的规格。

Result: 在新建的LeetCode-C-Spec（200道C题）上，迭代修正显著提升语法有效性；基于符号证明器的反驳机制在正确性评估中有效过滤了LLM评审常放过的假阳性规格。

Conclusion: 将神经生成与符号验证反馈结合，可有效合成面向内存安全系统软件的形式化函数规格，并提升可扩展形式化验证的可行性。

Abstract: Formal verification of memory-manipulating programs critically depends on precise function specifications that capture memory states written by experts. This requirement has become a major bottleneck as large language models (LLMs) increasingly generate low-level systems code whose correctness cannot be assumed. To enable scalable formal verification, we focus exclusively on function specification generation, deliberately avoiding the synthesis of complex loop invariants that are central to traditional verification pipelines. We propose a neuro-symbolic framework for automatically generating memory-aware formal function specifications for C programs from natural language problem descriptions and function signatures. The pipeline first produces candidate specifications via in-context learning, and then iteratively refines them using compiler diagnostics from symbolic provers and the verification toolchain. In particular, we validate candidate specifications by constructing a proof for the negation of the specification with concrete examples, enabling machine-checked rejection of plausible-but-incorrect specifications. To support systematic evaluation, we introduce LeetCode-C-Spec, a new benchmark of 200 C programming problems for generating memory-aware formal function specifications. Experiments show that iterative refinement substantially improves syntactic validity, while symbolic prover-based refutation significantly enhances correctness assessment by filtering false positives that LLM-only judges frequently accept. Our results demonstrate that combining neural generation with symbolic feedback provides an effective approach to formal specification synthesis for memory-safe systems software.

</details>


### [821] [EvoClaw: Evaluating AI Agents on Continuous Software Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13428)
*Gangda Deng,Zhaoling Chen,Zhongming Yu,Haoyang Fan,Yuhong Liu,Yuxin Yang,Dhruv Parikh,Rajgopal Kannan,Le Cong,Mengdi Wang,Qian Zhang,Viktor Prasanna,Xiangru Tang,Xingyao Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 构建EvoClaw以评估长期软件演化，结果显示智能体在持续维护中性能大幅下滑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准只评估一次性编码任务，忽视现实软件演化中的时间依赖与技术债。

Method: 提出DeepCommit从噪声提交日志重建可验证的里程碑DAG，并以此构建可执行序列，形成EvoClaw基准评估长期演化能力。

Result: 在12个前沿模型与4种框架评测中，连续设置下得分从>80%降至最多38%。

Conclusion: 现有智能体在长期软件演化场景表现显著下降，难以维持系统完整性并抑制错误累积。

Abstract: With AI agents increasingly deployed as long-running systems, it becomes essential to autonomously construct and continuously evolve customized software to enable interaction within dynamic environments. Yet, existing benchmarks evaluate agents on isolated, one-off coding tasks, neglecting the temporal dependencies and technical debt inherent in real-world software evolution. To bridge this gap, we introduce DeepCommit, an agentic pipeline that reconstructs verifiable Milestone DAGs from noisy commit logs, where milestones are defined as semantically cohesive development goals. These executable sequences enable EvoClaw, a novel benchmark that requires agents to sustain system integrity and limit error accumulation, dimensions of long-term software evolution largely missing from current benchmarks. Our evaluation of 12 frontier models across 4 agent frameworks reveals a critical vulnerability: overall performance scores drop significantly from $>$80% on isolated tasks to at most 38% in continuous settings, exposing agents' profound struggle with long-term maintenance and error propagation.

</details>


### [822] [NormCode Canvas: Making LLM Agentic Workflows Development Sustainable via Case-Based Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13443)
*Xin Guan,Yunshan Li,Ze Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: NormCode Canvas 把多步 LLM 工作流做成“分层案例推理系统”：运行时用检查点复用/修订，计划层用已编译计划递归学习；借助编译器验证作用域，系统实现可检查、可预审、可局部重跑，并在四个真实应用中验证了可部署性与持续自我改进能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动机是解决标准编排框架中常见问题：执行状态隐式共享导致检索不可靠、错误难以局部定位、重执行代价高、流程难以审查。作者希望将多步 LLM 流程构造成显式案例库，以提升可维护性与学习能力。

Method: 方法上，系统以 NormCode 为核心：其作用域规则经编译器验证，保证每个执行检查点都是自包含案例。Level 1 在运行时层面对检查点做案例推理：Fork 负责检索复用，Value Override 负责修订并自动传播过期边界。Level 2 在计划层面对“已编译计划”做抽象案例推理；且编译流水线本身也由 NormCode 计划实现，从而支持递归学习。

Result: 结果上，论文给出三项结构性性质：可直接检查检查点（C1）、可在执行前通过编译器叙事进行审查（C2）、可在作用域边界内选择性重执行（C3）。并以四个已部署计划作为证据：PPT Generation（商业 API 下约 40 秒/页）、Code Assistant（可执行最多十轮推理的软件工程任务）、NC Compilations（自然语言规格到可执行计划）、Canvas Assistant（联动外部代码编辑器自动调试计划）。

Conclusion: NormCode Canvas 通过两层案例推理与作用域受编译器验证的规划语言，将多步 LLM 工作流从“隐式共享状态”转为“可检索、可审查、可局部重执行”的案例化系统，并在真实部署中形成可自我改进的生态。

Abstract: We present NormCode Canvas (v1.1.3), a deployed system realizing Case-Based Reasoning at two levels for multi-step LLM workflows. The foundation is NormCode, a semi-formal planning language whose compiler-verified scope rule ensures every execution checkpoint is a genuinely self-contained case -- eliminating the implicit shared state that makes retrieval unreliable and failure non-localizable in standard orchestration frameworks. Level 1 treats each checkpoint as a concrete case (suspended runtime); Fork implements retrieve-and-reuse, Value Override implements revision with automatic stale-boundary propagation. Level 2 treats each compiled plan as an abstract case; the compilation pipeline is itself a NormCode plan, enabling recursive case learning. Three structural properties follow: (C1) direct checkpoint inspection; (C2) pre-execution review via compiler-generated narrative; (C3) scope-bounded selective re-execution. Four deployed plans serve as structured evidence: PPT Generation produces presentation decks at ~40s per slide on commercial APIs; Code Assistant carries out multi-step software-engineering tasks spanning up to ten reasoning cycles; NC Compilations converts natural-language specifications into executable NormCode plans; and Canvas Assistant, when connected to an external AI code editor, automates plan debugging. Together these plans form a self-sustaining ecosystem in which plans produce, debug, and refine one another -- realizing cumulative case-based learning at system scale.

</details>


### [823] [An Empirical Investigation of Pre-Trained Deep Learning Model Reuse in the Scientific Process](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13584)
*Nicholas M. Synovic,Karolina Ryzka,Alessandra V. Vellucci Solari,Kenny Lyons,James C. Davis,George K. Thiruvathukal*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 用自动化方法分析1.75万篇论文，发现自然科学中PTM复用以适配为主，生物化学相关领域最活跃，主要影响测试阶段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练专用深度学习模型成本高，科学界逐步复用预训练模型，但缺乏对自然科学中复用模式与影响的实证评估。

Method: 基于LLM驱动的自动化分析流水线，检索并分析2000-2025年间17,511篇开放获取论文，识别PTM复用类型、领域分布及影响阶段。

Result: 生物化学/遗传学/分子生物学复用最多；“适配”型复用最常见；科学过程中的“测试”阶段受影响最大。

Conclusion: 本文首次系统刻画了自然科学领域PTM复用现状与对科学过程的影响，为后续研究与实践提供基础。

Abstract: Deep learning has achieved recognition for its impact within natural sciences, however scientists are inhibited by the prohibitive technical cost and computational complexity of training project specific models from scratch. Following software engineering community guidance, natural scientists are reusing pre-trained deep learning models (PTMs) to amortize these costs. While prior works recommend PTM reuse patterns, to our knowledge, little work has been done to empirically evaluate their usage and impact within the natural sciences. We present the first empirical study of PTM reuse patterns in the natural sciences, quantifying the utilization and impact of conceptual, adaptation, and deployment reuse within the scientific process. Leveraging an automated large language model driven pipeline, we analyze 17,511 peer reviewed, open access papers to identify PTM reuse by scientific field, associated reuse patterns, and the impact of PTM integration into the scientific process from January 1st, 2000 to December 10th, 2025. Our results show that "Biochemistry, Genetics and Molecular Biology" has outpaced other natural scientific fields in PTM reuse, "adaptation" reuse is the most prevalent PTM reuse pattern identified across all natural science fields, and the "Test" stage of the scientific process has been most impacted by PTM integration. This aligns with the growing interest of leveraging computational methods to conduct high throughput, data driven scientific research. Our work characterizes and identifies current PTM reuse practices within the natural sciences, evaluates their impact on the scientific process, and establishes a foundation for future work into the implementation and broader scientific implications of PTM reuse.

</details>


### [824] [LLM-Augmented Release Intelligence: Automated Change Summarization and Impact Analysis in Cloud-Native CI/CD Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.14619)
*Happy Bhati*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出并落地了一个用于CI/CD晋级后的AI发布情报系统：自动筛选关键提交 + LLM结构化生成干系人报告 + 静态依赖分析量化影响范围，在真实Tekton/Kubernetes平台验证了其对内部发布沟通效率与准确性的提升，并指出LLM发布工程仍有挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云原生多阶段发布流水线复杂且任务独立版本化，环境晋级时变更沟通依赖人工，导致耗时、口径不一致、易遗漏，尤其在一次晋级包含多作者与多任务贡献时问题更严重。需要一种自动化、准确且可解释的内部发布沟通机制。

Method: 提出一个AI增强发布情报框架，包含三部分：1）自动收集提交并进行语义过滤，突出实质性变更、抑制例行维护噪声；2）使用结构化LLM生成按类别和干系人定制的晋级报告；3）进行静态任务-流水线依赖分析，将被修改任务映射到其参与的所有流水线并量化变更爆炸半径。该框架作为GitHub Actions触发的晋级后步骤，集成到生产级Kubernetes原生平台（Tekton任务/流水线）中。

Result: 在管理60+ Tekton任务与20+发布流水线的生产平台中完成架构与实现，并通过实例演练与对SmartNote、VerLog的定性比较，展示了该框架在内部晋级沟通场景下的适配性与差异化价值（尤其是依赖影响范围分析与干系人导向摘要）。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，将语义化提交筛选、结构化大模型总结与任务-流水线依赖分析集成到CI/CD晋级流程中，可以显著提升内部发布沟通的及时性、一致性与影响范围可见性；同时，内部晋级沟通与面向用户的发布说明在目标与信息粒度上存在本质差异，LLM驱动发布工程仍有开放挑战。

Abstract: Cloud-native software delivery platforms orchestrate releases through complex, multi-stage pipelines composed of dozens of independently versioned tasks. When code is promoted between environments -- development to staging, staging to production -- engineering teams need timely, accurate communication about what changed and what downstream components are affected. Manual preparation of such release communication is slow, inconsistent, and particularly error-prone in repositories where a single promotion may bundle contributions from many authors across numerous pipeline tasks. We present a framework for AI-augmented release intelligence that combines three capabilities: (1) automated commit collection with semantic filtering to surface substantive changes while suppressing routine maintenance, (2) structured large language model summarization that produces categorized, stakeholder-oriented promotion reports, and (3) static task-pipeline dependency analysis that maps modified tasks to every pipeline they participate in, quantifying the blast radius of each change. The framework is integrated directly into the CI/CD promotion workflow and operates as a post-promotion step triggered by GitHub Actions. We describe the architecture and implementation within a production Kubernetes-native release platform that manages over sixty Tekton tasks across more than twenty release pipelines. Through concrete walkthrough examples and qualitative comparison with recent tools such as SmartNote and VerLog, we discuss the distinctive requirements of internal promotion communication versus user-facing release notes and identify open challenges for LLM-driven release engineering.

</details>


### [825] [Beyond Local Code Optimization: Multi-Agent Reasoning for Software System Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.14703)
*Huiyun Peng,Parth Vinod Patil,Antonio Zhong Qiu,George K. Thiruvathukal,James C. Davis*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出一种面向微服务的全系统性能优化多智能体框架，通过融合程序流与架构依赖信息进行跨组件推理，并在PoC中取得+36.58%吞吐、-27.81%平均时延。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM/Agent的软件性能优化方法多停留在局部、语法驱动的代码变换，难以刻画程序行为及全系统性能交互；而现代软件由微服务、数据库和共享基础设施等组件构成，优化需要跨组件、跨层次的整体推理。

Method: 提出一个面向微服务的多智能体优化框架：融合控制流/数据流表示、系统架构信息与跨组件依赖信号，设置摘要、分析、优化、验证四类协同Agent，执行系统级性能推理与多步骤优化。并在微服务原型系统上进行PoC实验评估。

Result: 在所示微服务PoC中，框架实现吞吐量提升36.58%，平均响应时间降低27.81%，展示出跨组件性能优化的有效性。

Conclusion: 该研究初步验证了在微服务场景下进行“全系统级”自动性能优化是可行的。通过多智能体协同并结合程序流信息与架构依赖信号，能够识别跨组件瓶颈并生成跨栈优化方案，显著提升系统性能。

Abstract: Large language models and AI agents have recently shown promise in automating software performance optimization, but existing approaches predominantly rely on local, syntax-driven code transformations. This limits their ability to reason about program behavior and capture whole system performance interactions. As modern software increasingly comprises interacting components - such as microservices, databases, and shared infrastructure - effective code optimization requires reasoning about program structure and system architecture beyond individual functions or files. This paper explores the feasibility of whole system optimization for microservices. We introduce a multi-agent framework that integrates control-flow and data-flow representations with architectural and cross-component dependency signals to support system-level performance reasoning. The proposed system is decomposed into coordinated agent roles - summarization, analysis, optimization, and verification - that collaboratively identify cross-cutting bottlenecks and construct multi-step optimization strategies spanning the software stack. We present a proof-of-concept on a microservice-based system that illustrates the effectiveness of our proposed framework, achieving a 36.58% improvement in throughput and a 27.81% reduction in average response time.

</details>


### [826] [PCodeTrans: Translate Decompiled Pseudocode to Compilable and Executable Equivalent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.14855)
*Yuxin Cui,Zeyu Gao,Shuxian He,Siliang Qin,Chao Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: PCodeTrans结合动态验证与LLM反馈修复，使反编译代码可编译且与原二进制高度一致，性能大幅领先基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统反编译重可读性而轻可重编译性与运行时正确性，LLM方法易出现语义幻觉且缺乏动态验证，难以满足软件现代化与漏洞修复对行为等价的需求。

Method: 提出反馈驱动框架PCodeTrans：提取最小可编译上下文；将编译后的函数热替换进原二进制以保持真实执行环境；利用细粒度差分追踪生成运行时反馈，迭代引导LLM修复语义偏差。

Result: 在Coreutils与Binutils上，未剥离二进制实现100%函数级可编译性，分别达到99.55%与99.89%的测试验证一致性，修复76.56%与79.74%的测试暴露逻辑错误；在完全剥离二进制上仍保持>96%一致性。

Conclusion: PCodeTrans通过动态验证与反馈驱动修复，实现了可编译且行为一致的反编译代码，显著优于现有方法。

Abstract: Decompilation is foundational to binary analysis, yet conventional tools prioritize human readability over strict recompilability and verifiable runtime correctness. While recent LLM-based approaches attempt to refine decompiled pseudocode, they typically either optimize solely for readability or rely on static analysis for evaluation. This makes them prone to "semantic hallucinations" that compromise accuracy and fail to resolve actual runtime failures. For critical tasks like software modernization and vulnerability remediation, recovered code must not only compile but replicate the original binary's behavior. We present PCodeTrans, a feedback-driven framework that bridges the gap between decompilation, recompilation, and rigorous function-level dynamic validation. After extracting a minimal yet coherent context to guarantee recompilability, PCodeTrans employs an in situ substitutable engine to hot-swap the compiled function directly into the unmodified binary, natively preserving its authentic execution context and global dependencies. Guided by fine-grained differential tracing, PCodeTrans generates precise runtime feedback to iteratively guide an LLM in repairing semantic discrepancies. Evaluated on Coreutils and Binutils, PCodeTrans achieves unprecedented recovery performance when rectifying raw Hex-Rays outputs, attaining 100% function-level compilability on unstripped binaries alongside 99.55% and 99.89% test-validated behavioral consistency, respectively. In doing so, it resolves 76.56% and 79.74% of logic errors exposed by official test suites. Exhibiting exceptional resilience, PCodeTrans maintains over 96% behavioral consistency even on fully stripped binaries. By significantly outperforming all existing baselines, PCodeTrans paves a practical path to reliably translate decompiled pseudocode into compilable and executable equivalents.

</details>


### [827] [ITKIT: Feasible CT Image Analysis based on SimpleITK and MMEngine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.14255)
*Yiqin Zhang,Meiling Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: ITKIT提供DICOM到3D分割的完整易用管线，实验验证其能覆盖多数基础需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学影像分析框架众多，需在易用性与可配置性上提供更优选择。

Method: 构建ITKIT管线，提供CLI基础流程与OneDL-MMEngine高级配置与部署入口，并通过12个典型实验进行验证。

Result: 实验表明ITKIT可满足大多数基础场景需求，兼顾易用与扩展。

Conclusion: ITKIT具备从DICOM到3D分割推理的完整流程，适合多数基础应用场景。

Abstract: CT images are widely used in clinical diagnosis and treatment, and their data have formed a de facto standard - DICOM. It is clear and easy to use, and can be efficiently utilized by data-driven analysis methods such as deep learning. In the past decade, many program frameworks for medical image analysis have emerged in the open-source community. ITKIT analyzed the characteristics of these frameworks and hopes to provide a better choice in terms of ease of use and configurability. ITKIT offers a complete pipeline from DICOM to 3D segmentation inference. Its basic practice only includes some essential steps, enabling users with relatively weak computing capabilities to quickly get started using the CLI according to the documentation. For advanced users, the OneDL-MMEngine framework provides a flexible model configuration and deployment entry. This paper conducted 12 typical experiments to verify that ITKIT can meet the needs of most basic scenarios.

</details>


### [828] [Lore: Repurposing Git Commit Messages as a Structured Knowledge Protocol for AI Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15566)
*Ivan Stetsenko*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出 Lore：用 Git 原生 trailers 把 commit message 变成可检索的“决策记录”，补回代码变更背后的理由与约束；无需新基础设施、可被命令行与 AI 智能体直接发现和利用，并给出对比、反驳与后续验证路线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 AI 编码智能体同时成为代码生产者与消费者，传统 commit 只保留代码差异而丢失决策过程，导致组织性知识（为何这样改、受何约束、为何不选其他方案、未来意图）快速流失。论文将这类被丢弃的信息定义为“Decision Shadow”，并尝试系统化保存。

Method: 提出并形式化 Lore 协议：将提交信息结构化为“自包含决策记录”，字段涵盖约束条件、被否决方案、面向智能体的指令与验证元数据；实现上复用 Git trailers，并提供独立 CLI 进行查询；研究设计上还与五类替代方案做对比，针对关键反对意见进行压力测试，并给出后续实证评估路径。

Result: 从摘要看，论文主要产出是协议与论证框架而非大规模实证结果：给出 Lore 的协议定义、可直接落地的 Git+CLI 实现思路、与五种竞品路径的比较、对主要质疑点的压力测试，以及可执行的实证验证方案。

Conclusion: Lore 通过仅依赖 Git 原生能力（尤其是 trailers）把提交说明升级为可携带决策语义的记录，在不引入额外基础设施的前提下提升了代码决策知识的可保存性、可检索性与可被智能体消费性，具备现实可落地性与可验证性。

Abstract: As AI coding agents become both primary producers and consumers of source code, the software industry faces an accelerating loss of institutional knowledge. Each commit captures a code diff but discards the reasoning behind it - the constraints, rejected alternatives, and forward-looking context that shaped the decision. I term this discarded reasoning the Decision Shadow. This paper proposes Lore, a lightweight protocol that restructures commit messages - using native git trailers - into self-contained decision records carrying constraints, rejected alternatives, agent directives, and verification metadata. Lore requires no infrastructure beyond git, is queryable via a standalone CLI tool, and is discoverable by any agent capable of running shell commands. The paper formalizes the protocol, compares it against five competing approaches, stress-tests it against its strongest objections, and outlines an empirical validation path.

</details>
